anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.three_: Three leaves: Faith, Hope and Love. The grimoire of almost every mage.
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.four_l: Four leaves: the fourth leaf is Luck, Good Fortune. Rare, a sign of being chosen (as with Yuno).
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.five_l: Five leaves: the Devil's leaf. A forbidden, devil-bound grimoire (as with Asta's anti-magic book).
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.spade: Spade Kingdom suit cover: three-leaf rank, common (Faith, Hope, Love).
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.double: Spade Kingdom suit cover: four-leaf rank, rare, the luck leaf.
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.triple: Spade Kingdom suit cover: five-leaf rank, forbidden and devil-bound.
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.heart: Heart Kingdom suit cover: three-leaf rank, common (Faith, Hope, Love).
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.two_he: Heart Kingdom suit cover: four-leaf rank, rare, the luck leaf.
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.cracke: Heart Kingdom suit cover: three-leaf rank, common (Faith, Hope, Love).
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.diamon: Diamond Kingdom suit cover: three-leaf rank, common (Faith, Hope, Love).
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.five_s: Diamond Kingdom suit cover: four-leaf rank, rare, the luck leaf.
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.cracke: Diamond Kingdom suit cover: three-leaf rank, common (Faith, Hope, Love).
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.black_: Mod-only, not canon: a black grimoire written by the devil Liebe's power, above the five-leaf.
anime_multiverse.grimoire.meaning.god_ti: Mod-only, not canon: a legendary gold grimoire above every leaf, not devil-bound.
anime_multiverse.canon.luck: Luck: %s%% of spell hits deal x%s
anime_multiverse.canon.devil: Devil's price: it holds %s%% of your mana, and takes a little health when you are nearly dry
anime_multiverse.canon.fifth_leaf: The fifth leaf is not handed out. It is earned through despair, or a devil.
